summary: Represent a named ESM import as an immutable indirect live binding, never a copied value.

target.notes: The binding must dereference the exporter on every read, reject writes, and preserve uninitialized-binding ReferenceError behavior.

caveats: A C# local initialized from the export incorrectly snapshots it.
Cycles can expose an uninitialized target binding.

tests.name: observes exporter mutation
tests.input:
// a.mjs: export let n=1; export function inc(){n++}
// b.mjs: import {n,inc} from './a.mjs'; console.log(n); inc(); console.log(n);

tests.name: alias stays live
tests.input:
// a.mjs: export let value='a'; export const set=v=>value=v
// b.mjs: import {value as v,set} from './a.mjs'; set('b'); console.log(v);
